premises.text: Hosting on public clouds forces costly, tedious, error-prone server and networking management
premises.evidence_span: businesses spend billions of dollars in engineering costs just to manage servers on AWS

premises.text: Git push triggers fully automated build, deploy, secure updates, scaling, load balancing, and alerting without managing servers
premises.evidence_span: Simply push your code to Git. We automate everything from there

premises.text: Built-in service discovery, private networking, load balancing, managed SSDs with backups, and one-file infrastructure-as-code differentiate the managed cloud
premises.evidence_span: every Render service gets built-in service discovery, private networking, and load balancing

premises.text: The offering combines Heroku-like ease with greater flexibility and lower cost than stagnant managed clouds
premises.evidence_span: Amazing ease of use combined with tremendous flexibility

value.text: Developers deploy apps faster without managing servers, saving engineering cost
value.evidence_span: deploy anything from a simple static site to complex application clusters

causal_links.evidence_span: looking to save big on engineering costs

notes: Three launch innovations folded as feature cascade of one managed-cloud mechanism with git automation (v1.5.1). Heroku price comparison kept inside positioning premise rather than separate viability module. Revenue growth and request volume excluded as traction.
